How to race
  • Drift: hold Jump while you turn. Blue sparks fly, then orange and then purple; when you let go, a mini-boost that's longer the higher the level.
  • Ramps: in the air press Jump for a stunt; it gives you a boost when you land.
  • Coins: each one raises your top speed, up to 10. A spin-out loses you 3.
  • Shortcuts: a dirt strip with the green SHORTCUT sign. Off the track the grass slows you down, except on the shortcut or with a boost.
  • Water sections: blue stretches across the track; the kart splashes and goes slower, except with a boost or jumping.
  • Start lights: three red lights, one a second; on green, go!
  • Yellow arrows on the ground: a 2-second boost.
  • Round blue puddles: they slow you down and make you skid.
  • «?» boxes: they give you an item; use it with Action.
